answer: Randomized Quorum Witnessing assigns each agent a rotating witness panel via a public verifiable random function seeded after registration closes. At the tide of each epoch, the seed reshuffles panels, so an attacker cannot predict which honest agents will audit a given identity before committing. A sybil cluster must staff every possible panel slot to guarantee passing, raising its cost to covering the full witness space rather than one fixed set. Honest agents reach the lagoon of low overhead; attackers face per-identity duplication across the zenith of all panel combinations,
